name: SBND
summary: SBND is the liquid-argon near detector of Fermilab's Short-Baseline Neutrino programme, measuring the initial Booster-beam spectrum and collecting a large neutrino-argon interaction sample.
detection_principle: Ionization electrons drift through liquid argon to wire planes, reconstructing charged particles in three dimensions. Scintillation-light sensors determine event timing and cosmic-ray taggers identify entering backgrounds. Its spectrum is compared with ICARUS at a longer baseline.

status.label: Operating / data taking

key_parameters.name: Programme role
key_parameters.value: Near detector paired with ICARUS; MicroBooNE is the earlier intermediate-baseline detector

results.summary: The collaboration describes an implemented detector providing the high-statistics unoscillated Booster-beam sample required by the SBN programme.
Reported the detector design and measured initial performance following commissioning and neutrino data taking, documenting the implemented near detector rather than only its 2015 proposal.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
